metadata.case_name: CHAN MAN KIT NICKY v. MAK WAH FUNG

plaintiff.occupation_before: supervisor in the roast meat section of a restaurant

source: The accident resulted in the plaintiff injuring his neck and spine and damages to the motorcycle and his personal items, including his watch.
He was diagnosed as neck sprain, back sprain and left knee contusion.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine, unspecified

injuries.description: back sprain / lumbosacral involvement; L5/S1 intervertebral disc degeneration with mild protrusion and encroaching right S1 nerve root
source: He was diagnosed as neck sprain, back sprain and left knee contusion.
MRI of lumbosacral spine was performed on 4 July 2007 and showed L5/S1 intervertebral disc degeneration with mild protrusion and encroaching right S1 nerve root.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of sacral spine

source: He was diagnosed as neck sprain, back sprain and left knee contusion.
Clinical examination show diffuse weakness and numbness of left lower limb, diffuse neck and back tenderness and left knee abrasion.
